_about: List prices in USD for US East (N. Virginia), copied from the AWS Price List API (https://pricing.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/offers/v1.0/aws/<service>/current/us-east-1/index.json). Copied on 2026-10-16: AWSIoT 20261003053120, AmazonKinesisFirehose 20260911124446, AmazonAthena 20260911124408, AmazonCloudWatch 20261007115540, AWSQueueService 20260911124607, AWSGlue 20261012185542, AmazonDynamoDB 20260911124422 (provisioned capacity). Copied on 2026-10-13 for chapter 1 and reused: AWSLambda 20261012223257, AmazonDynamoDB 20260911124422 (on-demand), AmazonS3 20261012231102. Where a price has tiers, the tiers used by cost.py are listed; everything else is first tier. No free-tier allowance is applied anywhere. Re-check before quoting to anyone.
